test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-II Official Paper (Held On: 02 May, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 1.
solution:
The correct answer is** 'curious'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Contextually, the term '**curious**' best fits into the first blank. The writer is indicating a desire to learn and understand the difference between '**hearing**' and '**listening**'.
 
• The term '**curious**' signifies an eagerness to know or learn something which aligns with the context of the sentence.
 
• The other options i.e. '**joyous**', '**nervous**', and '**suspicious**' indicate emotional states which don't align with the discussion of a learned concept.
 
• Also, the ensuing discussion about distinguishing '**hearing**' and '**listening**' is an academic pursuit which aligns with curiosity rather than the other states.

Therefore, the correct answer is** Option 2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• 'Curious' stems from the Latin term ‘curiosus’ which means 'careful’ or ‘diligent’.
